pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

head.desc: the head: sly lidded eye, arched brow, big round nose; pivot at the neck (0, 13), the collar covers it

head_blink.desc: eye shut; pivot at the neck (0, 13), the collar covers it

head_talk.desc: mouth open (under the moustache); pivot at the neck (0, 13), the collar covers it

head_gold.desc: eyes gone gold (ch6: looking into the compass); pivot at the neck (0, 13), the collar covers it

mustache.desc: the curled moustache, its curl swept forward and up; pivot under the nose, for the talk wiggle

hat.desc: the tall minister's hat, crepe band and strawberry jewel; pivot at the brow

robe.desc: the portly robe: cream, strawberry trim, gold sash and buttons, a crepe ruff; the root card, pivot at the hips' base (0, 1.5)

cape.desc: the cape, behind the robe: golden crepe with browned spots and a scalloped, folded edge; pivot at the neck (1, 14.5)

arm_front.desc: the front arm: wide cream sleeve, red cuff, white glove; pivot at the shoulder

arm_back.desc: the back arm, a tone darker: wide cream sleeve, red cuff, white glove; pivot at the shoulder

foot_front.desc: a plum court shoe with a curled toe; pivot at the ankle

foot_back.desc: a plum court shoe with a curled toe, a tone darker; pivot at the ankle

scroll.desc: the letter (ch0): a scroll with a red wax seal; pivot at its middle, held in the front glove

compass_base.desc: the Marvelous Compass's base (ch0): a gold ring of seven sockets, one section intact; pivot at its centre, held in the front glove
